<!--
  Add the `review` label if this pull request touches source.

  Automated review is opt-in: `.greptile/config.json` sets `labels: ["review"]`,
  so a pull request without that label is NOT reviewed. Nothing reports this —
  an unreviewed pull request looks exactly like one that was reviewed and found
  nothing. The label is the only thing that starts it.

  Leave it off for a pull request that changes no source: a version bump, a spec
  sync or archive, a docs-only edit.

  Deterministic checks (`checks`, `collision-check`, `decision-records`) run on
  every pull request regardless, and remain the merge gate — reviewer findings
  are advisory and post no status (ADR-0029).
-->
